profile.title: Computational Building Designer & BIM Engineering Specialist
profile.tagline: Integrating parametric geometry, automated BIM-to-BEM interoperability pipelines, and multi-objective environmental optimization for high-performance sustainable architecture.

projects.title: Mr. Chi MAOAO Restaurant & Coast Bar
projects.subtitle: Urban Heat Island (UHI) & Autodesk Forma Microclimate Analysis
projects.summary: Practical thesis investigation on Urban Heat Island (UHI) mitigation along the coastal landscape. Integrating thermal imaging drone observation with Autodesk Forma early-stage solar radiation and wind simulations. The white reflecting canopy geometry and aerodynamic corridors mitigate heat absorption while framing sea horizons.

details.concept: Analyzing thermal radiation stark contrast between rock surfaces (34.1°C) and shaded vegetative corridors (<28.9°C). Autodesk Forma solar hour simulations guided the roof curvature to shelter visitors from extreme noon exposure while inviting prevailing coastal sea breezes through winding corridors.
details.materials: High-albedo white roof membranes, local basalt aggregate concrete, low-E operable double glazing, salt-resistant timber louvers.
details.awards: Special Topics on Professional Practices: Urban Heat Island in Taipei (Advisor: Dr. Lucky S.J. Tsaih)

items.title: Jingmei VOUTE: Gallery & Bistro
items.subtitle: Adaptive Masonry Arch Atrium & Cultural Bistro
items.summary: Adaptive cultural composite featuring a 3F/4F triple-height atrium gallery, cultural design shop, and rooftop sky bar beneath rhythmic masonry brick arches.

details.concept: Carving a continuous vertical daylight void through an urban street-block parcel, using paraboloid brick vaults to diffuse top-lit sunshine into the lower exhibition galleries.
details.materials: Hand-laid red clay masonry arches, board-formed architectural concrete, blackened steel mezzanine walkways, acoustic timber ceilings.
details.awards: NTUST Architectural Design Studio II • Featured Tectonic Section Model

items.title: NTUST Hsinchu Campus (NDCC)
items.subtitle: Solar-Responsive Academic Courtyard & Research Complex
items.summary: Comprehensive campus design featuring extensive sunshine analysis, shaded sunken courtyards, and open collaborative architectural design labs.

details.concept: Orienting academic wings along prevailing Hsinchu wind axes while stepping terrace roofs to maximize winter solar gain and summer self-shading.
details.materials: Precast concrete sun-breakers, laminated low-iron glazing, permeable campus paving, native windbreak landscaping.
details.awards: NTUST Architectural Design Studio • Campus Masterplan Commendation

items.title: Gulin Garden Parent-Child Center
items.subtitle: Biophilic Cylindrical Volumes & Community Courtyard
items.summary: A dynamic organic morphology composed of interlinked cylindrical volumes, grey brickwork, wooden louvers, and perforated mesh railings.

details.concept: Replacing rigid institutional corridors with interlocking circular play pavilions that wrap around existing heritage trees and biophilic sensory gardens.
details.materials: Perforated grey masonry screen walls, warm cedar vertical louvers, cushioned cork flooring, seamless curved safetymesh.
details.awards: Urban Community Architecture Studio • Taipei Guling Street Revitalization

projects.title: Zhongshan CURVED Youth Hostel
projects.subtitle: Wave-form Urban Facade & Community Permeability
projects.summary: A 7-story urban boutique youth hostel defined by sculptural, wave-like cantilevered balconies that generate dynamic street rhythms. The ground floor dissolves into a public courtyard and community cafe, fostering spontaneous encounters between international travelers and local neighborhood residents.

details.concept: The continuous sinuous floorplates serve as passive solar sunshades for the guest rooms, reducing summer cooling requirements while offering private green micro-terraces facing the city tree canopies.
details.materials: Architectural fair-faced white concrete, acoustic double-glazed window assemblies, vertical greenery planter boxes, custom modular timber bunk joinery.
details.awards: Design Studio III Project 113 • Selected for Departmental Exhibition

items.title: TAC: Temporary Art Space in Sharjah
items.subtitle: Tensile Climatic Canopy & Modular Cultural Pods
items.summary: International architecture competition entry exploring tensile fabric canopies, Souk Al Bahar cultural corridors, and modular public gathering pods.

details.concept: Deploying a lightweight double-skin PTFE tensile roof that induces stack-effect natural ventilation above modular timber exhibition pavilions in the arid Sharjah climate.
details.materials: PTFE tensile membrane, CNC-milled glulam timber ribs, rammed earth plinths, woven palm-fiber shading screens.
details.awards: 2025 International Architecture Competition Entry • Sharjah Cultural District

items.title: Origami Gradient Color & Light
items.subtitle: Hochschule München (HM) Exchange Studio & Timber Tectonics
items.summary: Tectonic folding studies developed during visiting exchange at Hochschule München, examining light refraction through origami louver assemblies.

details.concept: Parametric Miura-ori folding geometry translated into kinetic facade louvers that modulate chromatic daylight transmission and solar heat gain across seasonal sun angles in Munich.
details.materials: Birch aircraft plywood, dichromatic acrylic films, CNC-scored folding hinges, precision aluminum sub-frames.
details.awards: Visiting Exchange Scholarship • Hochschule München (HM) Department of Architecture (2025)

items.title: TTDA Digital Fabrication & 3D Prototyping
items.subtitle: Songshan Solo Graduation Exhibition & High-Precision FabLab
items.location: NTUST TTDA FabLab & Songshan Cultural Park
items.summary: Precision multi-material SLA/FDM 3D printing and laser-cut spatial joinery models; serving as Core FabLab Manager instructing 80+ peers.

details.concept: Bridging digital Grasshopper/Revit parametric geometry with physical multi-axis fabrication, structural node 3D printing, and full-scale exhibition curation at Songshan Cultural Park.
details.materials: SLA Tough Resin, carbon-fiber reinforced PLA, laser-cut basswood & anodized aluminum, custom G-code toolpaths.
details.awards: NTUST TTDA FabLab Manager • Songshan Cultural Park Solo Exhibition Curator

projects.title: BIM-to-BEM Interoperability & EnergyPlus Calibration
projects.subtitle: Automated gbXML Thermal Validation Pipeline & Optimization
projects.summary: Graduate research resolving geometric distortion and thermal zoning disconnects between Autodesk Revit and EnergyPlus. Implemented an automated gbXML validation workflow slashing topological error to below 5%, coupled with NSGA-II genetic algorithms to balance sDA/ASE daylighting against cooling energy.

details.concept: Bridging architectural BIM and thermal simulation (BEM). By scripting automated Revit API analytical space boundaries, the framework resolves non-manifold surface geometry prior to EnergyPlus simulation.
details.materials: Autodesk Revit API, EnergyPlus, Python, gbXML Schema, NSGA-II Multi-Objective Optimization.
details.awards: 15%–25% Simulated Building Energy Savings | Autodesk Revit ACU Certified | Benchmarked to LEED EAc2 & Taiwan BERS
